title: Organic Cheese Cloths, GOTS Certified, Grade 100, 36x36Inch, Reusable Cheese Cloth with Closed Edges Fabric Fine Mesh Cloth, Unbleached Cotton Muslin Cheesecloth for Straining,Cooking,Crafts - 9 Sq.Ft
description:
About this item
GOTS Certified. Made from 100% organic cotton, no odor, no GMOs, no highly hazardous chemicals, and no child labor.
Large Size - Free cut into desired size. Closed Edges & No Shed Lint - Prevent small threads drop in the food. Easy Clean - Reused many times with a simple rinse, finally worn it out, then compost it.
SGS Tested Grade 100 - Our woven fabrics is 56x41. Didn't reduce threads. No Easy to Tear - The higher threads per square inch, the higher cost. You got what you pay.
Truly Chemical Free - Stuff poultry, wrap spices, craft customized projects, even use as cheesecloth table runner, all without plastic. Unbleached Organic Cotton - Strain almond milk, cold brew coffee, juice, and any other foods without worrying.
FSC Certified. Packed with biodegradable packaging to fulfill the promise of being truly plastic-free! Good for the environment and be beneficial to your family's health. You can strain the food with confidence.
